method: Agent-assisted retrospective review of company, utility, commission, county, municipal, and local reporting sources. Each event retains a direct source link and separately bounded numeric facts.

projects.name: Meta Lebanon Data Center
projects.summary: Meta is constructing a 1 GW AI-capable campus representing more than $10 billion of investment.
projects.risk: The 1 GW disclosure is not explicitly bounded as utility, facility, or critical-IT load.

projects.name: AWS Northwest Louisiana Campus Portfolio
projects.summary: Three planned AWS campuses across Caddo and Bossier Parishes.
projects.risk: Portfolio-level announcement; campus parcels, loads, and schedules need separate resolution.

projects.name: AWS Mississippi Expansion Portfolio
projects.summary: An additional $12 billion of AWS investment across Hinds and Madison Counties.
projects.risk: Multi-facility portfolio; split when parcel-level evidence surfaces.

projects.name: Muskie Data Campus
projects.summary: TeraWulf controls a 1+ GW Eastern Kentucky site with executed power agreements.
projects.risk: No tenant or project financing disclosed; 1+ GW is long-term potential.

projects.name: Delta Forge 2
projects.summary: A 210 MW critical-IT lease at Applied Digital's fifth AI Factory campus in an undisclosed southern state.
projects.risk: State, county, parcel, utility, construction, and financing remain undisclosed.

projects.name: Justified Data Campus
projects.summary: A 401 MW Anthropic lease backed by approved electric service up to 482 MW.
projects.risk: Construction, financing, and delivery remain forward-looking.

projects.name: Merlin Data Campus
projects.summary: A 500-acre Galaxy site with 74 MW initial utility support and potential expansion to 500 MW.
projects.risk: Only the initial utility phase is supported by a disclosed agreement.

projects.name: Chesapeake Data Campus
projects.summary: Proposed redevelopment of the Morgantown generating station into an integrated energy and data campus.
projects.risk: Acquisition remains subject to closing conditions; data-center operations are long-dated.

projects.name: Apollo Data Center Site
projects.summary: An optioned 288-acre site with potential for up to 900 MW.
projects.risk: No tenant, committed interconnection, financing, or construction schedule disclosed.

projects.name: Caspian Data Campus
projects.summary: A named Texas site with potential for 700 MW subject to ERCOT interconnection.
projects.risk: County, parcel, tenant, schedule, and committed power remain undisclosed.

projects.name: Selene Data Campus
projects.summary: A separate named Texas site with potential for 900 MW subject to ERCOT interconnection.
projects.risk: County, parcel, tenant, schedule, and committed power remain undisclosed.

projects.name: AWS Wharton County Campus
projects.summary: A 13-building AWS campus outside Boling with site preparation underway.
projects.risk: Campus MW, capex, parcel, service agreement, and delivery schedule are not disclosed.

projects.name: Google Van Buren Township Data Center
projects.summary: Project Cannoli is a proposed 1 GW Google campus advancing through township and MPSC review.
projects.risk: Final township approvals and utility-contract protections remain contested.

projects.name: Project Evest
projects.summary: A second Meta hyperscale campus adjacent to Project Laidley with a project-specific generation and transmission program.
projects.risk: Treat as distinct from Laidley; federal and state approvals remain active.

projects.name: Unidentified Richland-area 2.64-GW Hyperscale Campus
projects.summary: A federal notice describes a 2.64 GW hyperscale load and a 27-mile 500 kV grid build.
projects.risk: Customer identity is not stated; keep separate from Evest until directly linked.

projects.name: Alliant Beaver Dam Data Center
projects.summary: A previously untracked Beaver Dam campus with a commission-approved single-customer agreement.
projects.risk: Customer, load, parcel, and construction schedule are undisclosed.

projects.name: Global AI Windsor
projects.summary: Reuse of the former Kodak-Carestream industrial facility for a data center.
projects.risk: Building, utility, fire, and environmental permits remain.

projects.name: Project Taurus
projects.summary: Proposed reuse of the former Intel facility now in a delayed appeal process.
projects.risk: City Council postponed a final decision until April 2027.

projects.name: DeSoto County Industrial Park Data Center
DataOne / Nebius Vineland AI Data Center

events.headline: Meta breaks ground on 1 GW Lebanon, Indiana campus
events.evidence: Meta began construction on a 1 GW campus representing more than $10 billion.

events.headline: AWS announces $12B Northwest Louisiana data-center buildout
events.evidence: Multiple campuses were announced across Caddo and Bossier Parishes.

events.headline: Lake Mariner reaches 60 MW of revenue-generating AI capacity
events.evidence: TeraWulf reported 60 MW energized for Core42 and producing revenue.

events.headline: Amazon raises Mississippi data-center program to $25B
events.evidence: Amazon added $11B in Madison County and $1B for a Hinds County plant conversion.

events.headline: Cipher reports Barber Lake building topped out
events.evidence: The principal building topped out while MEP and networking work continued.

events.headline: Black Pearl Phase II site work begins
events.evidence: Phase II ground and site work began while Phase I retrofit continued.

events.headline: Beacon Point secures first 352 MW IT lease
events.evidence: Phase 1 is covered by a 352 MW, 15-year lease.

events.headline: Hut 8 commits $16M to River Bend-area water infrastructure
events.evidence: The commitment funds water-system capacity alongside campus development.

events.headline: Polaris Forge 3 secures 300 MW hyperscaler lease
events.evidence: A 15-year lease covers 300 MW critical IT backed by about 430 MW utility power.

events.headline: TeraWulf closes acquisition of 1+ GW Muskie site
events.evidence: The acquisition includes controlled land plus power agreements.

events.headline: Applied Digital unveils Delta Forge 2 with 210 MW lease
events.evidence: A 210 MW, 15-year lease supports a new southern-state campus.

events.headline: Anthropic signs 401 MW lease at Justified Data Campus
events.evidence: Anthropic leased roughly 401 MW for 20 years at the Hawesville campus.

events.headline: TeraWulf sells its 50.1% Abernathy interest to Fluidstack-led buyers
events.evidence: TeraWulf agreed to sell its controlling joint-venture stake.

events.headline: Second 352 MW lease fully commercializes Beacon Point
events.evidence: A second lease doubled contracted IT to 704 MW.

events.headline: Meta and BlackRock form El Paso data-center venture
events.evidence: BlackRock-managed funds receive 80%, Meta retains 20%, and Meta leases the campus.

events.headline: Galaxy acquires 500-acre Merlin campus in McGregor
events.evidence: Galaxy secured land plus an initial utility-interconnection agreement.

events.headline: FERC clears a key condition for TeraWulf's Chesapeake acquisition
events.evidence: FERC authorized the pending acquisition of the Morgantown generating station.

events.headline: Black Pearl delivers first HPC capacity and starts rent
events.evidence: First capacity was delivered in early August and rent commenced two months early.

events.headline: Cipher secures option on 900 MW Apollo site
events.evidence: Apollo is a 288-acre optioned site submitted as studied load.

events.headline: Lake Mariner CB-3 lifts revenue-generating capacity to 102 MW
events.evidence: CB-3 completion raised revenue-generating IT capacity and activated Google support.

events.headline: Galaxy discloses acquisition of Caspian data-center site
events.evidence: Galaxy acquired Caspian subject to ERCOT interconnection.

events.headline: Galaxy discloses acquisition of Selene data-center site
events.evidence: Galaxy separately lists Selene with potential capacity subject to ERCOT review.

events.headline: AWS expands Northwest Louisiana program to $18B and three campuses
events.evidence: Amazon raised planned investment by $6B and added a third Shreveport campus.

events.headline: Kentucky PSC approves 482 MW service agreement for Justified
events.evidence: The commission approved retail electric service supporting the campus.

events.headline: Amazon confirms site preparation for 13-building Wharton County campus
events.evidence: Amazon plans 13 buildings outside Boling and has begun site preparation.

events.headline: Minnkota seeks approval for the Agassiz 345-kV line and substation serving Polaris Forge 2
events.evidence: The application describes the dedicated line and substation south of Harwood.

events.headline: North Dakota PSC schedules hearing on the transmission project for Polaris Forge 2
events.evidence: The notice links the $75 million Agassiz project to Polaris Forge 2.

events.headline: PSC permits preliminary Agassiz grading before final transmission approval
events.evidence: A temporary variance allowed grading and protective matting while final approval remained pending.

events.headline: North Dakota PSC unanimously approves PF2's Agassiz transmission project
events.evidence: Final approval cleared the dedicated line and substation for a 280 MW large load.

events.headline: Oliver County adopts a 180-day data-center moratorium during PF3 planning
events.evidence: Official minutes record the temporary development moratorium.

events.headline: Oliver County lifts its data-center moratorium
events.evidence: Commissioners voted 3-0 to rescind the moratorium.

events.headline: Oliver County calendars PF3 building permit for two data-center buildings
events.evidence: The agenda lists permit 1096 for two data-center buildings and a security building; it does not prove approval.

events.headline: Oliver County schedules Applied Digital road-use agreement for special meeting
events.evidence: The agenda places a road-use and operation agreement before commissioners; it does not prove execution.

events.headline: Michigan AG moves to reopen conditional approval of DTE contracts for The Barn
events.evidence: The challenge alleged that DTE had not accepted ratepayer-protection conditions.

events.headline: MPSC approves 332 MW of DTE battery storage dedicated to The Barn
events.evidence: Three storage projects totaling 332 MW were approved and contract rehearing requests were denied.

events.headline: MPSC places The Barn ahead of ordinary customers in emergency load shedding
events.evidence: The 1,383 MW campus and future qualifying large loads must be curtailed before firm customers.

events.headline: Google proposes a new AI data center in Van Buren Township
events.evidence: The state release identifies Google, Van Buren Township, and a contested MPSC process.

events.headline: Michigan AG challenges cost protections in DTE's 1-GW Google contracts
events.evidence: Testimony addresses 20-year supply and clean-capacity agreements for the 1 GW project.

events.headline: Port Washington seeks PSC approval for an $11.4M water main serving the Jacquard campus
events.evidence: Docket 4780-CW-105 describes the route, demand, fire flow, cost, and 2027 construction window.

events.headline: Wisconsin PSC revokes completeness of the Ozaukee transmission application
events.evidence: The project association is a geographic inference; the application must be refiled.

events.headline: Louisiana confirms Meta's second Richland Parish hyperscale campus, Project Evest
events.source_name: Louisiana Economic Development filing at LPSC
events.evidence: The filing identifies Evest as a Meta affiliate planning a second campus adjacent to Laidley.

events.headline: Entergy files a 5.278-GW generation and transmission plan for Project Evest
events.source_name: Louisiana Public Service Commission / Entergy Louisiana
events.evidence: The application seeks seven combined-cycle units, storage, a substation, and major transmission.

events.headline: Army Corps opens review of a westward Evest-Laidley campus expansion
events.source_name: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Vicksburg District
events.evidence: Public notice MVK-2024-00740 names both Evest and Laidley and describes the expansion footprint.

events.headline: Federal notice reveals a 27-mile, 500-kV grid build for a 2.64-GW Louisiana data center
events.source_name: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Vicksburg District
events.evidence: The notice does not identify the hyperscale customer.

events.headline: Wisconsin PSC modifies Alliant's single-customer agreement for a Beaver Dam data center
events.evidence: The commission strengthened termination, reporting, financial, efficiency, and renewable provisions.

events.headline: Weld County unanimously grants Global AI its final land-use permit
events.evidence: Commissioners approved USR26-0019 for reuse of an existing industrial facility.

events.headline: Colorado Springs delays Project Taurus appeal decision for seven months
events.evidence: City Council postponed a decision until April 13, 2027 after an 11-hour appeal hearing.

events.headline: Van Buren Township advances 1-GW Project Cannoli
events.evidence: The Planning Commission granted preliminary site-plan approval with conditions.

events.headline: Edgerton City Council overturns denial of DAMAC Project Heartland site plan
events.evidence: Council reversed the Planning Commission's denial of final site plan FSP2026-0002.

events.headline: Provo Planning Commission approves East Bay data-center plan and advances overlay
events.evidence: The project plan passed unanimously and the overlay rezoning advanced 5-2.

events.headline: Trenton unanimously approves Project Mila site plan
events.evidence: Approved minutes cover a multi-building campus at 3000 Arnold Brown Industrial Drive.

events.headline: St. Louis grants conditional-use permit for Armory Innovation data center
events.evidence: The permit includes environmental and community-benefit conditions.

events.headline: DeSoto County approves DCIP data-center PUD and concept plan
events.evidence: The board approved rezoning RZNE-0077-2025 and a concept plan with on-site generation.

events.headline: Vineland approves fuel-cell and LNG phase for 300-MW AI data center
events.evidence: The second-phase site plan enables fuel cells and on-site LNG storage.

events.headline: Kearney approves 368-MW Horizon 1 data-center CUP
events.evidence: CUP 2026-04 enables a three-phase conversion and expansion of an existing cryptocurrency site.

events.headline: Stafford Planning Commission recommends Accokeek Center campus and substation
events.evidence: Rezoning and a substation CUP advanced on separate 4-3 advisory votes.

events.headline: Lyon County approves Monarch Data Center rezoning
events.evidence: Commissioners approved the tentative PUD and rezoning pathway.

events.headline: Iron County unanimously approves Antelope Data Campus CUP
events.evidence: The permit covers a five-building campus with scalable on-site gas generation.

events.headline: New Albany approves STACK entry and stormwater redesign
events.source_name: City of New Albany Planning Commission
events.evidence: The modification relocates the entry drive and basin around a utility easement.

events.headline: Wisconsin Rapids planners unanimously recommend denying paper-mill data center
events.evidence: The Planning Commission voted against both the CUP and site-plan application.

events.headline: AWS withdraws Calvert Technology Center application
events.evidence: Amazon Data Services formally withdrew conceptual site-plan application SPI2026-0021.

events.headline: Natelli withdraws New Hill Digital Campus annexation and rezoning
events.evidence: Approved minutes state that the applications were withdrawn.

events.headline: Beale Infrastructure withdraws Project Atlas rezoning
events.evidence: The developer pulled the rezoning application before the scheduled council proceeding.

events.headline: Developer withdraws controversial Lisle data-center application
events.evidence: Cloud Centers withdrew the active municipal application.

events.headline: Forsyth County denies Project Iron Spur rezoning near Rural Hall
events.evidence: The county denied the rezoning request for the proposed data-center site.

events.headline: Microsoft completes construction on first Fairwater Wisconsin datacenter facility
events.evidence: Microsoft announced completion of the first datacenter facility in Mount Pleasant.

events.headline: QTS withdraws its Greater Madison data-center project
events.evidence: QTS published an update withdrawing the greater Madison proposal.

events.headline: HMC withdraws the 1977 Saturn data-center application in Monterey Park
events.evidence: A signed letter formally withdraws the proposal.

events.headline: Edgecombe County AI data-center proposal is withdrawn
events.evidence: The proposal was withdrawn while county officials considered a development moratorium.
